subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

A dialogue is a ______ between two or more people.
solution:
The correct answer is "**conversation**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• In the given sentence, what a dialogue is exactly is to be filled in the blank.
 
• **The discussion that occurs between two or more people is described in the sentence as a dialogue**.
 
• Now, let us explore the meaning of the given options:
 
 
• Conversation means a talk between two or more people.
 
 
• Example: To solve your misunderstandings you both need to have a conversation.
 
 
 
• Commission means an official group of people who are asked to find out about something.
 
 
• Example: A commission was appointed to investigate the cause of the mishap.
 
 
 
• Convertible means something that is able to change into another form.
 
 
• Example: The bonds are convertible into stocks.
 
 
 
• Conversion means the process of being converted.
 
 
• Example: They have suggested the conversion of the old building into new apartments.
 
 
 
 
 
• From the meanings of the words we can infer that "conversation" is the word which expresses the character of the dialogue that takes place between two or more people.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1) Conversation.
